ja270:1.1: Sabbehi kira ñātīhi kosiyo issaro kato, sace ñātīh' anuññāto bhaṇeyy' āhaṃ ekavāciyan ti.
ja270:2.1: Bhaṇa samma anuññāto atthaṃ dhammañ ca kevalaṃ, santi hi daharā pakkhī paññāvanto jutindharā ti.
ja270:3.1: Na me ruccati bhaddaṃ vo ulūkassābhisecanaṃ, akuddhassa mukhaṃ passa, kathaṃ kuddho karissatīti.
